name: Private Dick: Lipstick & Lies
source:
Private Dick: Lipstick & Lies is an hard-boiled, erotic visual novel. This ain't a love story.

Step into a seedy modern world of deception, betrayal and scheming, laced with a whiskey haze and lashings of joyful depravity.

P.D. Sam Steele is in a rut. His clients have dried up, his useless secretary is demanding her paycheck, and his ex-girlfriend has broken the sanctity of his favourite bar. It's almost a relief when a fresh case walks through the door. Almost.

A missing dog, an unrequited debt and a sudden kidnapping all come to a head in a dingy motel out of town.

[From [url=https://ciscodonovan.itch.io/red-tie]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Private Dick: Lipstick & Lies》是一部硬汉派情色视觉小说。这可不是什么爱情故事。

踏入这个肮脏的现代世界吧：谎言、背叛与阴谋交织，威士忌带来的迷蒙醉意中，还掺着大把纵情堕落的欢愉。

私家侦探萨姆·斯蒂尔陷入了困境。客户没了，没用的秘书还在追讨工资，前女友甚至闯入了他最爱的酒吧，搅了他的清静。于是，当一桩新委托找上门时，他几乎松了一口气。只是几乎。

一条失踪的狗、一笔未偿的债，以及一场突如其来的绑架，最终在城外一家阴暗破旧的汽车旅馆汇聚，引爆危机。

[摘自[url=https://ciscodonovan.itch.io/red-tie]Itch.io[/url]]
